summary: Added /* Knowledge Page */ CSS section (~150 lines) to styles.css after the Orchestrator widget classes section.

Implemented .knowledge-tabs (flex container with bottom border track) and .knowledge-tab (tab button with transparent bottom border, hover/active states using --color-ready for both text and border-bottom-color).
Added .badge-scope-global (blue tones: #dbeafe bg / #1d4ed8 text) and .badge-scope-project (green tones: #dcfce7 bg / #15803d text) extending the existing .badge pattern.
Added .knowledge-actions (flex container for card action buttons) and .knowledge-move-input (inline-flex for project-slug input + confirm button).

All colour-dependent classes have [data-theme='dark'] overrides: badge-scope-global (#1e3a5f / #93c5fd), badge-scope-project (#14532d / #86efac), category-pill (surface/muted/border tokens), tag-chip (#3b0764 / #d8b4fe), knowledge-move-input .form-control (surface tokens).
Verified --radius-pill is defined at line 44 of :root.
No existing CSS classes were modified.

comments.note: .confidence-label uses a hard-coded font-style: italic which is a minor convention assumption — if confidence display evolves to include icons or numeric indicators, the italic style may need to be reconsidered. No action needed now.

styles.css is now ~2590 lines and growing. The file is well-structured with clearly labelled section comments, but consideration of splitting into per-page CSS modules (e.g. knowledge.css, orchestrator.css) would improve long-term maintainability. Out of scope for this WP — noted for future architectural discussion.

.knowledge-move-input dark override targets .knowledge-move-input .form-control rather than the container itself, consistent with how dark mode handles .filter-bar inputs. This is correct but adds a selector-dependency on .form-control being a child — if the markup changes, the dark override silently stops applying. Noted as a fragility.

summary: [PASS] Knowledge Page CSS section in styles.css passes all four review dimensions. The implementation is clean, consistent with established codebase patterns, and correctly handles both light and dark mode.

comments.note: Pattern consistency verified: .badge-scope-global and .badge-scope-project correctly follow the established multi-class composition pattern (e.g. 'badge badge-scope-global'). They are color-only classes, exactly like .badge-ready, .badge-runner-vscode, etc. The base .badge class supplies layout and typography. No inheritance issue.

.knowledge-tab uses the correct 'margin-bottom: -2px' overlap technique to make the active border-bottom sit on top of the track border. This is a well-established CSS tab pattern and is correctly applied here.

[data-theme='dark'] .category-pill redundantly re-declares 'color: var(--color-text-muted)' — the variable already switches value in dark mode automatically. This is harmless and defensive (explicit intent), so no fix needed. Worth noting as a minor convention question for the project.

[documentation-forward] The Knowledge Page CSS block consolidates all [data-theme='dark'] overrides at the bottom of the section rather than co-locating them with each rule. This is a clean organizational decision that differs from some earlier sections in styles.css which inline dark overrides adjacent to their light counterparts. A brief comment in the README or CONTRIBUTING guide noting the preferred dark-mode convention for new CSS sections would help future contributors stay consistent.

No blocking or significant issues found. The file remains purely additive (confirmed by QA via git diff). All 8 new classes are present, all 6 acceptance criteria are met, dark-mode coverage is complete, and no existing rules were altered.
